stories.headline: Adam Hamilton, Megachurch Pastor, Won a Democratic Senate Primary. Now Comes the Hard Part.
stories.summary: The leader of America’s biggest United Methodist congregation secured a swift victory in the August 4 primary election, making him the Democratic nominee for the United States Senate in Kansas. Now, the prominent minister faces an uphill battle to win the general election in a historically conservative state. If successful, he would end a nearly hundred-year drought for Democrats representing Kansas in the Senate.
